issue.title: sase_gateway fleet mutate/launch route tests fail at sase-core 17947a0 (seeded fleet row missing, launch receipt never settles)
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-108.1 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #1) while verifying the Rust link-location grammar. Reproduced by the sase-108 land agent on 2026-09-13. sase-108 did not touch `crates/sase_gateway`.

`cargo test -p sase_gateway --lib` fails 3 of 164 tests at sase-core origin/master `17947a0`. It failed the same way on two consecutive runs.

1. `routes::tests::fleet_mutate_refuses_terminal_missing_capability_and_bridge_failure` panics at `crates/sase_gateway/src/routes.rs:6400` with `seeded fleet row`. `first_summary` gets an empty Presentation catalog page (`include_terminal: true`) for the agent seeded by `seed_fleet_agent(tmp, "mobile-demo", false, false)`. This also fails when the test runs alone, so it is deterministic.
2. `routes::tests::fleet_launch_accepts_scoped_request_and_returns_receipt` and `routes::tests::fleet_launch_omits_bridge_name_when_prompt_has_id` panic at `routes.rs:6496` with `fleet launch receipt never reached state settled`. `wait_for_launch_receipt_state` polls 50 times at 20 ms intervals. Both tests fail every time in the full crate run and pass when run alone. The fixed 1 s budget, or state shared across tests, may not hold under the crate's parallel test run.

Suspected cause (not confirmed): sase-core `84f9776` (2026-09-12, "fix(fleet): honor dismissals of definitively dead agent records", no SASE_BEAD trailer) changed `crates/sase_gateway/src/fleet_reads.rs` and `agent_scan/index.rs`. It now resolves owner liveness before dismissal lineage. A seeded fixture agent with no live process may now count as definitively dead and be dropped from the presentation catalog. Before choosing between a fixture fix and a product fix, confirm with `git bisect` or by running the tests at `84f9776^`.

Repro: from a sase-core checkout, run `cargo test -p sase_gateway --lib`.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The seeded-fleet-row panic happens both when the test runs alone and in the full crate run. The two fleet_launch receipt tests failed 2 of 2 full cargo test -p sase_gateway --lib runs on the same unchanged tree, so they are not intermittent under the standard gate.

payload.entry: Related: sase-zz (remote stop missing lifecycle.stop capability never settles) covers the same fleet mutation refusal path as the failing fleet_mutate test. A typed related link could not be written because the hidden plans clone held another agent's untracked links file.

evidence.note: PROPOSED BY sase-zt.6.1 note #2: independent preexisting reproduction on sase-core a64c40d/ba651fe lineage; routes::tests::fleet_mutate_refuses_terminal_missing_capability_and_bridge_failure failed in isolation at first_summary because the seeded fleet catalog row was absent. The queue-capacity phase did not touch sase_gateway. This matches sase-10a's deterministic seeded-row root cause and impact.

PROPOSED BY sase-zl.13.11.5 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #1), recorded by sase-zl.13.11.land: independent reproduction on origin/master during ancestry_retention verification 2026-09-13 - routes::tests::fleet_mutate_refuses_terminal_missing_capability_and_bridge_failure failed isolated 5/5 at 'seeded fleet row' (terminal seed live=false/proc=false), unchanged by the ancestry_retention diff and still failing after stashing it; sibling live-seed fleet_mutate tests passed. Also matches the receipt-settle detail: fleet_launch_accepts_scoped_request_and_returns_receipt and fleet_launch_omits_bridge_name_when_prompt_has_id passed 3/3 isolated but failed under cargo test --workspace.
